idea-plugin.name: Chevron Lists
idea-plugin.description:
Chevron Lists turns your JetBrains IDE into a fully-featured task, notes, and project management system - without leaving markdown. It layers >, >>, >>> blockquote nesting onto plain .md files for clean, readable hierarchies that render the same everywhere markdown is supported.

Features

  • Syntax highlighting - chevron prefixes are coloured so section structure stands out at a glance.
  • Live diagnostics - duplicate > Section headers, duplicate ## markdown subheadings, broken numbered-list sequences, and empty sections all get warning underlines with helpful hover messages.
  • Smart Enter key - pressing Enter on a chevron line continues the list automatically (>> - after a bullet, >> 2. after >> 1., etc.). Empty list items break out of the list.
  • Auto-fix numbering - broken sequences like >> 1., >> 2., >> 2. renumber themselves silently as you type. Lists in different sections stay independent.
  • Item actions - toggle done (Ctrl+Alt+D), star (⭐), pin (📌), flag (🚩), and note (📝) on a single item or across a multi-line selection. Right-click in the editor or use Ctrl+Shift+A → CL:.
  • Settings panel - under Settings → Tools → Chevron Lists you can choose the bullet character (-, *, etc.), make new lists default to numbered, and toggle auto-fix.

Example

> Today's Tasks
>> 1. Review PR #142
>> 2. ⭐ Ship Chevron Lists JetBrains v0.8
>> 3. 🚩 Investigate memory leak report

> Notes
>> - 📌 Team retro on Friday at 14:00

About

This is the official JetBrains port of the Chevron Lists VS Code extension. Markdown files written in either editor render identically in the other - both plugins share the same syntax and conventions.

Source code, issue tracker, and contributions: github.com/LewisIsWorking/ChevronListsJetBrains
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.7.0

  • Added CL: Toggle Star (⭐), Toggle Pin (📌), Toggle Flag (🚩), and Toggle Note (📝) actions.
  • Markers can coexist on the same item; multi-line selection toggles all items in the range.

0.6.0

  • Added CL: Toggle Done (Ctrl+Alt+D) action with multi-line selection support.

0.5.0

  • Added auto-fix numbering as you type (250ms debounce, on by default).
  • Renamed dropdown labels to Bullet list (>> -) and Numbered list (>> 1.).

0.4.0

  • Added a settings panel under Settings → Tools → Chevron Lists.

0.3.0

  • Enter key continues chevron lists automatically; empty items break out of the list.

0.2.0

  • Diagnostics for broken numbered sequences and empty sections.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: chevron syntax highlighting, duplicate-header and duplicate-subheading warnings.
